analysis:
Both units are the base-side text of provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/KVCacheSSD/SSDPrefixCacheTests.swift; the only change is test-only. The head patch adds two tests at about lines 3140-3240: remembersHeaderVerdictsOnlyForUnchangedFiles and replacedLookalikeIsReadAgain. They exercise SSDWholeRootMaintainer's memoization of DBK3 header-ownership verdicts, which is production behavior under T-041. Cache verdicts are expected to be invalidated by a ctime/inode change even when size and mtime are restored. The visible base text is existing tests: whole-root maintenance, ownership of lookalike files, symlinked-root refusal, temp-file TTL and exact-name ownership, the per-donation gate, write-behind queue bounds, donation outcomes, and the windowed sidecar. It contains no production code.

The security-relevant property under test is that unowned or malformed files are never deleted or counted, and that a stale cached 'owned' verdict cannot let the maintainer treat a tampered file as owned. The tests assert this fail-closed behavior. The production change that introduces the verdict cache (likely SSDWholeRootMaintainer) is not in this batch. Whether it is keyed on device, inode, size, mtime and ctime, and whether the cache is bounded, therefore cannot be verified here and should be checked in the source file passes.

I found no regression in the supplied evidence. The patch excerpt is truncated, so the second new test is only partly visible.
